evidence_slice: Newham Council's Regulation 19 Draft Submission Local Plan 2024 Part 2 maps 45 site allocations and identifies N11.SA3 within Beckton. Newham Council's 2025 Green and Water Infrastructure Strategy contains a dedicated 'N11.SA3 Alpine Way' assessment and states the site contains the Alpine Walk and Winder Terrace green corridors, with recommended pocket park, public square and publicly accessible playspace improvements. On 18 August 2026 Newham Council received the Inspector's Report concluding the Local Plan is legally compliant and sound subject to Main Modifications; formal adoption by Full Council remained pending.
